sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:12

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:12:1
items.html: In every phase and degree these 320 continue to be clarified, until the end of Assiya, etc., for the whole matter is reckoned by the 320 sparks: As he explains, this was the number of the sparks that fell within the vessels when they broke. And it is known that the ten Sefirot are each included of one another, and therefore there is no phase that is clarified and rises out of BYA without all 320 sparks being included in it — for this very inclusion was the cause of their breaking, as will be explained below. Hence they need the couplings of AVI to clarify and separate from them the judgments and the dross that come from the mixture of the last thirty-two sparks, which are the discernment of the bottom Hey without the sweetening of the quality of mercy; and then they become fit for the clothing of the lights within them, as will be explained below.
